body:
See the changelog for full details

## What's Changed
* #94 tracking tokenized regions by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/95
* A sans-io API for ninep by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/97
* contrib: add a simple markdown preview script by @davcam in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/100
* issue-53 async command execution by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/103
* A bunch of improvements to the ninep crate by @bjorn3 in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/105
* feat: reducing allocations in the 9p protocol layer by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/107
* feat: #77 supporting renaming of open buffers by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/109
* Adding a scratch buffer #26 by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/113
* Issue #98 -resizing window and columns by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/116
* Searching for multi-byte utf-8 characters in the minibuffer results in a panic by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/128
* Add support for LSP completions by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/133
* Remove incorrect truncation of TUI minibuffer lines by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/138
* feat: Fast Scrolling by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/139
* Fix GapBuffer::char_to_byte behaviour for single line buffers ending in a multi-byte character by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/142
* Rename config languages section to filetypes by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/144
* Add smarter treatment of dot when inserting via xdot by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/145
* Rename environment variables for spawned commands by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/148
* Add support for transient scratch buffers by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/149
* Add bash lsp configuration by @junkblocker in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/151
* Reduce allocations in the TUI renderer by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/153
* Overhaul exec by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/154
* Use Structex for edit expressions by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/157
* Prevent crash in keybinding parsing for Config by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/160
* Custom keymaps should override by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/162
* Support running external programs in exec scripts by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/163
* Fix invalid leading literal calculations #165 by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/166
* Tree sitter plumbing rules by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/167
* Support resizing UI layout using the mouse by @sminez in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/168

## New Contributors
* @bjorn3 made their first contribution in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/105
* @junkblocker made their first contribution in https://github.com/sminez/ad/pull/151

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sminez/ad/compare/0.3.1...0.4.0
